algorithm: MeshLink/1 post-quantum link handshake (Noise XXhfs, XXhfs+psk3)

notes.ReferenceKeys: Keys, ephemerals and KEM inputs come from fixed labels in tools/reference. Private keys are the raw 32 B X25519 inputs. kem_keygen_seed is the FIPS 203 ML-KEM.KeyGen_internal seed d ‖ z; kem_encaps_seed is the ML-KEM.Encaps_internal message m.
notes.Replay: Each side writes its message from its inputs and the payload. messages are the bytes as delivered: a writer's own output equals them except at tampered_step. The reader of rejected_step must fail the handshake; every earlier message must succeed.
notes.Tampered: One bit flipped in transit at tampered_step.
notes.Prologue: The two sides hold different prologues, so message 2 fails.
notes.Psk: The two sides hold different mesh keys, so message 3 fails.

tests.comment: e1 KEM public key changed in message 1
encrypted static key changed in message 3
responder read a different capability record
